messages:
ada: heads-up — after the compact-scheduler v2 rollout at ~13:02 UTC we're seeing ~120 Pending GPU pods in us-west1-b. Nodes report free GPUs but scheduler is refusing placement.

mike: can you paste the kubectl pending lines + one node describe?

ada: snippet:```
$ kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep Pending | head
trainer-mini-01   Pending   0/1 nodes are available: 2 node(s) had incompatible GPU flavor.
llm-embed-07      Pending   0/1 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate.
tiny-gang-c       Pending   0/1 nodes are available: 3 node(s) had insufficient nvidia.com/gpu.
```

ada: `kubectl describe node usw1-rack23-node7` excerpt:```
Taints: gpu-shape=2xA100:NoSchedule
Capacity: nvidia.com/gpu=4
Allocatable: nvidia.com/gpu=4
Allocated resources: nvidia.com/gpu: 0
Conditions: Ready
```

julia: interesting. allocatable shows 4 GPUs free but taint prevents scheduling. compact-scheduler v2 tightened shape affinity to avoid mixing NVLINK topologies. tiny jobs don't set a preferred shape so they end up failing the strict check.

mike: that matches. The coalescer now requires exact shape match by default; previously small pods could be colocated. The change reduced NVLINK regressions for large jobs but is starving small latency-sensitive workloads.

sre-ops: correlating metrics — egress for that rack surged at rollout time (https://metrics/redwood/usw1/egress). Spreading tiny jobs across racks increases dataset egress/staging.

nora: options: 1) hotfix scheduler to relax shape matching for pods <=2 GPUs, 2) inject an annotation/toleration for tiny-gang pods to accept mixed shapes, 3) roll back the rollout. Thoughts?

ada: prefer 1) hotfix to avoid rollback churn. small jobs are latency-sensitive and we shouldn't block them.

mike: proposed hotfix: coalescer will use a looser threshold for small pods. config diff:```yaml
coalescer:
  exact_shape_match: true
  small_pod_shape_relaxation: 0.6  # apply when resource.gpus <= 2
```

julia: add unit tests and run canary in us-west1-c first. ops, can you schedule a 15m patch window?

sre-ops: patch in 10 minutes. we'll do rolling restart of scheduler pods, no node drains. temporary alert mute for 30m.

deploy-bot: compact-scheduler v2 patch initiated by nora at 1778884450. progress: 1/3 scheduler pods updated.

ada: canary results: Pending count dropped from ~120 -> 9 within 4m. NIC egress fell ~38%.

mike: good. follow-ups: 1) update pod templates to include gpu-preferred-shape where appropriate, 2) document scheduler fallback rules, 3) run a simulation to quantify NVLINK perf regression for relaxed placements.

nora: filed INF-4287 for docs/tests/sim and assigned to platform team.

julia: quick cost note — small-job scattering caused ~12% uplift in egress spend for the last 12h in us-west1. tag the ticket with cost impact.

ada: thanks all. I'll keep watching metrics and post a short incident note if anything else crops up. :thumbsup:
